footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income: includes €217M from profit from equity method investments.

Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 15.6% to €32.7B in 2025. Gross margin was 52.8%, versus 51.3% a year earlier, and operating income rose 25.3% to €11.3B, a 34.6% margin.
Net income rose 26.9% to €9.6B, or €24.71 per share. Operating cash flow was €12.7B and free cash flow €11.1B, versus €9.1B; ASML returned €6.0B through buybacks.
watch: Cost of revenue is 47% of revenue.
sources: ASML Holding N.V. Form 20-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
